question:
Choose the option that has an error in the sentence.

Nowadays, the lack of money makes people spend too much times working.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "too much times working" in part **3**.
 
• The word "**times**" is incorrect in this context. The correct word should be "**time**" because "time" in this sense is an uncountable noun.
 
• The phrase should be corrected to "too much time working," which aligns with standard grammar rules.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Nowadays, the lack of money makes people spend too much time working."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Nowadays, the lack of money" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2:** "makes people spend" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4:** "No correction required" – This option is incorrect because there is an error in part 3.
